title: Prediction Markets as Macro Derivatives: A Simulation Framework for Portfolio Hedging with Event Contracts
abstract: First empirical framework for evaluating institutional viability of event contract hedging. Models 383 Kalshi contracts across 58 macro events (Fed rate + CPI, 2022–2024) as binary derivatives using modified Black-Scholes on VIX surface. At 1% NAV: hedged Sharpe 0.538 vs unhedged 0.065. Quantifies basis risk (100% CPI accuracy, 0% FOMC — a market efficiency finding), hedge efficiency decay, and AUM ceiling ($148K current → $14.8M at 100× ADV). JEL: G11, G13, G14, G18.
author: Kalra, S.

title: PIE: Physics-Inspired Contrastive Learning for Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: Bag-of-Curves negative sample generation (gamma, sigmoid, logarithmic curves), contrastive learning with Gram matrix triplet loss + InfoNCE objective, unsupervised superpixel segmentation for regional brightness consistency. Evaluated on LOL dataset and real-world smartphone images. Outperforms RetinexNet (20.7 PSNR), Zero-DCE (21.5), EnlightenGAN (20.9). PIE achieves 24.3 PSNR, 0.89 SSIM.
author: Kalra, S.

title: Bitcoin Volatility and Regime Forecasting: A Comparative Analysis of Time Series Models
abstract: Comparative analysis of OLS, ARIMA, GARCH(1,1) on Bitcoin returns. Confirms Weak-Form EMH — 50% directional accuracy for OLS/ARIMA. GARCH(1,1): α=0.089, β=0.895, persistence=0.984. Crisis simulation across COVID-19 crash, Terra/Luna collapse, FTX bankruptcy, 2021 bull run. Bull/Bear regime classification showing asymmetric duration and 2–3× volatility differential.
author: Kalra, S.

title: PACER: Pressure-Adaptive Continuous Epoch Reclamation for MVCC Databases
abstract: Novel MVCC garbage collection algorithm. Key innovations: continuous pressure adaptation (not discrete tiers), snapshot coalescing to minimize write amplification under high-concurrency workloads, and lock-free design throughout. Accompanied by C++ simulation of 100–200 concurrent processes with varying resource and security profiles. IEEE-formatted academic report.
author: Kalra, S.
